It will cover both core ability cadence and cooldown usage in dungeons and raids for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b].

sections.heading: How to Play Death Knight
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Death Knight"][color=c6]Death Knight Blood Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]
[wrapper width=600px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]

[table]

[tr]
[td width=10%][icon name=ability_deathknight_brittlebones size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
[td][b]Manage buffs and debuffs[/b]
From being rewarded with bonus armor and Runic Power cost reduction from [spell=195181] to [spell=273946] to amplify your self-healing, these simple buffs are core to your rotation. You don't need to go out of your way for them, either![/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
[tr]
[td width=10%][icon name=inv_sword_07 size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
[td][b]Keep cooldowns on cooldown[/b]
[spell=49028] and all your defensive cooldowns are the bread and butter of the spec![/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
[tr][td width=10%][icon name=spell_deathknight_butcher2 size=medium type=round color=c6 inline=true][/icon][/td]
[td][b]Optimize resources[/b]
The rest of the spec revolves around spending Runes to convert them into Runic Power as efficiently as possible. More Runic Power = more [spell=49998]![/td][/tr][/table]

[/td][/tr][/table]
[hr]
If you're looking for a more bite-sized explanation, check out our starter guide below:

[center][cta-button=guide/classes/death-knight/blood/basics icon=spell_deathknight_bloodpresence color=c6]Blood Death Knight Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center][/center]
[/box][/wrapper]

sections.heading: Rotation Priority
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="Rotation Priority"][icon name=spell_deathknight_bloodpresence type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon] Best Death Knight Blood Rotation[/h2]

Below, we break down the main priority lists for Death Knight Blood: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and your opener sequence.

[wrapper width=70%][box border=true]
[h3 type=bar toc=false]Hero Talent Master Switches[/h3]
[pad]
You can use the master switches below to flip the [b][i]entire page's[/i][/b] options to your selected choice. Bear in mind, [b][color=q6]current recommendation in all content is[/color] [symbol=wow-hero-talent-sanlayn] [color=#CE655E]San'layn[/color] or [symbol=wow-hero-talent-deathbringer] [color=#9BE2E2]Deathbringer[/color] on pure single target and [symbol=wow-hero-talent-sanlayn] [color=#CE655E]San'layn[/color] everywhere else[/b].

[center]
[wrapper width=620px]
[grid]
[display-option="DB" radio="HeroTalent" color=death-knight icon=inv_polearm_2h_titanargus_d_01 color=death-knight]Deathbringer[/display-option]
[display-option="SL" checked radio="HeroTalent"  icon=inv_ability_sanlayndeathknight_vampiricstrike color=death-knight]San'layn[/display-option]
[/grid]
[div display-options="DB"]
[minor-heading type=bar toc=false][color=c6][icon name=spell_deathknight_bloodpresence type=round size=small inline=true color=death-knight][/icon] Options[/color][/minor-heading]
[center][wrapper]
[grid]
[display-option="DB-Cons" icon=inv_axe_2h_artifactmaw_d_01 color=death-knight group="DB-ST"][spell=1263824][/display-option]
[display-option="DB-Onslaught" icon=ability_demonhunter_soulcleave2 color=death-knight  group="DB-ST"][spell=469870][/display-option]
[/grid]
[/wrapper][/center]
[/div]

[div display-options="SL"]
[minor-heading type=bar toc=false][color=c6][icon name=spell_deathknight_bloodpresence type=round size=small inline=true color=death-knight][/icon] Options[/color][/minor-heading]
[center][wrapper]
[grid]
[display-option="SL-Cons" icon=inv_axe_2h_artifactmaw_d_01 color=death-knight][spell=1263824][/display-option]
[/grid]
[/wrapper][/center]
[/div]
[/wrapper]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]

[pad]

[tab name="Single-Target Priority" icon=spell_holy_divinespirit]
	[h3 toc="Single Target Priority" type=bar][color=c6] Best Death Knight Blood Single Target Rotation[/color][/h3]
	[pad]
	Blood Death Knight's single target rotation operates on a priority list, maintaining two crucial buffs and using resources to optimize Runic Power generation. Every GCD depends on the current state of resources and active abilities at your disposal. As a result, this section should be read as a priority list, and not a strict sequence.

	[div display-options="!(DB)&!(SL)"]
	[center][box border=true]
	[b][symbol=wow-atlas-quest-legendary-available] Please select a Hero Talent option to generate a Single Target priority[/b]
	[/box][/center]
	[/div]

[wrapper width=850px]
	[div display-options="DB"]
	[wrapper][center][box border=true][center][small][i]The builds used below are covered in the [url guide=3128]Talents page[/url]. Anywhere you see the [span class=tip tooltip=NotesHighlight][symbol=wow-atlas-quest-wrapper-turnin][/span] icon, you can hover over it for additional notes.[/i][/small][/center]
	[/box][/center]
	[/wrapper]

	[symbol=wow-hero-talent-deathbringer] [b][color=#9BE2E2]Deathbringer[/color][/b] puts a strong emphasis on its signature ability, [spell=439843], and the subsequent procs and effects it generates when it expires. The rotational gameplay is otherwise the same, with a much smaller focus on the management of [spell=195181] thanks to the charges [spell=439843] indirectly provides.
	[h3 type=bar toc=false]Priority[/h3]

[ol]
[li]Cast [spell=49998] if you need the healing or are above 75 Runic Power[toggler id=db_why_75 hidden]Why 75?[/toggler]
[div id=db_why_75 hidden]This is an arbitrary breakpoint that is a measured amount. It attempts to solve two problems:
[ul]
  [li]With it at around this value, you always have two [spell=49998] available to you[/li]
  [li]You also need 45 RP - two to three full [spell=206930] - to overcap Runic Power[/li]
[/ul]
You can adjust this threshold as you see fit[/div][/li]
[li]Maintain at least 5 charges of [spell=195181]. If [spell=195181] is about to expire, press [spell=195182] [toggler id=bone_shield_generator_db_st hidden]Are there other generators?[/toggler]
[div id=bone_shield_generator_db_st hidden]As [symbol=wow-hero-talent-deathbringer] [color=#9BE2E2]Deathbringer[/color], every 45 seconds, you will predictably gain two [spell=441378] charges, guaranteeing a [spell=195181] duration refresh and additional charges. On top of this, if you play [spell=1265855], you are also guaranteed to come out of [spell=49028] at essentially [spell=195181] cap.

The problem with this is that, depending on how early you spend those [spell=441378], you may need to add one [spell=195181] generator at the halfway point between [spell=49028].

If you are already on 8+ bones and do not have a problem in taunting a target, [spell=49576] works as an effective [spell=195181] refresh.
[/div][/li]
[li display-options="DB-Onslaught"]Cast [spell=43265] and stand in it if you are not currently affected by the buff it provides.[/li]
[li display-options="!DB-Onslaught"]Cast [spell=43265] and stand in it if you have a [spell=81136] proc.[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=439843] on cooldown[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=49028] on cooldown[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=50842] if [spell=49028] is active and your target does not have [spell=55078] on it, [b]or[/b] if you are about to cap on its charges[/li]
[li display-options="DB-EchoingFury&DB-Onslaught"]Spend [b]one[/b] of the [spell=441378] charges [spell=1265855] provided before [spell=439843] detonates[/li]
[li display-options="DB-EchoingFury&!DB-Onslaught"]Spend all the [spell=441378] charges [spell=1265855] provided before [spell=439843] detonates[/li]
[li display-options="DB-Cons"]Cast [spell=1263824] if the hard-casted version of [spell=49028] is not active. Empower it to rank 1.[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=50842] if you have a [spell=1265790] proc[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=206930] as a filler. Do not run out of runes, particularly around the 45-second mark when [spell=439843] is about to come off cooldown[/li]
[/ol]

[symbol=wow-hero-talent-sanlayn] [b][color=#CE655E]San'layn[/color][/b] greatly empowers [spell=49028] while also forcing the player in a feat-or-famine cycle around [spell=433925], a buff that can easily be stacked and refreshed during [spell=49028]. Outside of this window of strength, this buff can only be refreshed as an infrequent proc on [spell=49998] - and a player needs to generate at least one proc every 20 seconds for up to 75 seconds to keep the stacks rolling, in order not to have to spend their entire time re-stacking it during the next [spell=49028]. The gameplay changes this brings are much more rigid and tactical.

	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c6]Priority[/color][/h3]

[h4 type=bar]In [spell=434152][/h4]
[ol]

[li]Cast [spell=49998] if you need the healing or are above 75 Runic Power[toggler id=sl_why_75_indrw hidden]Why 75?[/toggler]

[li]Maintain at least 5 charges of [spell=195181].[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=50842] if the [spell=55078] copy from [spell=49028] is not currently on your target[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=43265] if you have a [spell=81136] proc[/li]
[li]Fill with [spell=433895][/li]
[li]If you run out of runes, cast [spell=50842][/li]
[/ol]

[h4 type=bar]Outside [spell=434152][/h4]

[li]Cast [spell=49998] if you need the healing or are above 75 Runic Power[toggler id=sl_why_75_outdrw hidden]Why 75?[/toggler]

[div id=bone_shield_generator_sl_st_outdrw hidden]If you are already on 8+ bones and do not have a problem in taunting a target, [spell=49576] works as an effective [spell=195181] refresh. [spell=195292] is usable in this exact scenario if you cannot afford to taunt something.
[/div][/li]
[li display-options="SL-Cons"]Empower [spell=1263824] to rank 1[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=43265] and stand in it if you get a [spell=81136] proc and [spell=434157] is not currently active.[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=50842] if you have a [spell=1265790] proc[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=433895] if it is available[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=50842] to prevent its charges from capping[/li]
[li]Cast [spell=206930][/li]
[/ol]

[/wrapper]
[/tab]

[tab name="Opener" icon=ability_vehicle_launchplayer]
[h3 toc="Opener" type=bar][color=c6] Best Death Knight Blood Opener[/color][/h3]
	[pad]
Your opener as a Blood Death Knight depends on your Hero Talent choice. In both cases, your goal is to set up as many maintenance buffs as you can before the fight starts to cut down on wasteful GCDs you would spend doing so otherwise.

In the following section, we will assume that you are in control of pulling and can spend two global cooldowns preparing things.

	[div display-options="!DB&!SL"]
	[center]
	[box border=true]

sections.body:
[h2 toc=false type=bar]Pre-Combat Check[/h2]
	
Whilst Blood has no strict pre-combat checklist of group buffs and personal temporary buffs, there are still a couple of valuable resources you can prepare before a fight starts. We have detailed them below:

[h3 type=bar]Raid[/h3]
[center][wrapper width=800px][box]
[ul]
[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Check Consumables -[/b] [color=q0]Flask, food, augment rune, temporary weapon oils or whetstones are worth having at all times.[/color][/li]
[/ul]
[/box][/wrapper][/center]

[h3 type=bar]Mythic+[/h3]

[center][wrapper width=800px][box]
[ul]
[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Conserve Resources Between Pulls -[/b] [color=q0][spell=195181] persists between pulls as long as it has time remaining on it, and Runic Power decays at a rate of 1 RP/second out of combat. This allows you to keep [spell=195181] rolling by refreshing it at the end of a pull, and to pool some Runic Power to kickstart your next pull. Skip the maintenance buff minigame by getting ahead of these two resources![/color][/li]
[li icon=exclamation-circle][b]Key Start Optimization -[/b] [color=q0]The start of a key leaves your [spell=195181] charges intact and leaves up to 25 Runic Power when the key starts. You can prepare both resources by hitting enemies or target dummies before the key is inserted if you are not in combat when it starts.[/color][/li]
[/ul]
[/box][/wrapper][/center]
[/tab]
[/tabs]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c6][icon name=spell_shadow_lifedrain type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon] Blood Death Knight Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]

Blood has access to a [i]single[/i] offensive cooldown outside of its Hero Talent trees in Midnight, in the form of [spell=49028]. In addition to this, a number of defensive cooldowns are available, all with differing impact and niches. We have covered how they work, including all of the intricacies and niche use cases they may have below.

[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Dancing Rune Weapon" icon=inv_sword_07]
[h3 type=bar toc=false][icon name=inv_sword_07 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon][color=c6] Dancing Rune Weapon[/color][/h3]

[spell=49028] grants you 30% parry for 12 seconds when cast, replicates a small subset of abilities ([spell=206930], [spell=195182], [spell=50842] and [spell=49998]) and has two additional effects:
[ul]
  [li]If you cast [spell=195182] while it is active, you get 3 bonus [spell=195181] for each [spell=49028] active[/li]
  [li]If you cast [spell=50842] while it is active, each [spell=49028] applies its own copy of [spell=55078][/li]
[/ul]

You can empower this spell through other talents, granting you 5% bonus parry for the first 8 seconds of it, and up to 10 Runic Power per second for the first 8 seconds. [symbol=wow-hero-talent-sanlayn] [color=#CE655E]San'layn[/color] takes this up a notch by using this as their main activator for all Hero Talent mechanics.

[/tab]
[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c6][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c6][/icon] Death Knight Blood Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]

[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Bone Shield management" icon=ability_deathknight_boneshield]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c6] Bone Shield Management [/color][/h3]
The largest remaining optimization around Blood's toolkit and rotation involves familiarizing yourself with [spell=195181] generators. Every 30 seconds, you will have to use [i]one[/i] of them to refresh bones.

As [symbol=wow-hero-talent-deathbringer] [color=#9BE2E2]Deathbringer[/color], when playing [spell=469870], this is effectively dealt with for you. When playing [spell=436687], you can choose to delay one [spell=441378] explosion by ~5 seconds to fix this; alternatively, you can slot in a [spell=49576] to refresh your entire stack.

[spell=195181] management is significantly harder as [symbol=wow-hero-talent-sanlayn] [color=#CE655E]San'layn[/color], due to the hero talent not having [i]any[/i] passive generation tools. You are left to your own devices - and to make things even worse, Apex talents have effectively randomized how many [spell=195181] charges a single [spell=195182] provides, since each Apex [spell=49028] provides its own bonus three stacks. Proper UI tracking goes a long way towards solving this, but there is still an element of skill involved.
[/tab]
